title: HostLinkAttachRequest
description: Strict internal control request asking one Host incarnation (host_id, host_generation) to make one session resident by creating or restoring it. It carries no lease epoch: a cold attach acquires one and an attach to an already-resident session returns the existing one; the reply is a HostLinkRegistryObservation or a HostLinkError. actor_id is the requesting service identity, not an end user. It carries no client authority or runtime payload.

id.description: Opaque UTF-8 control identity; Core enforces the 256-byte limit.
